load_dataset_aria: load an Aria dataset and return a DataLoader for 3D Gaussian Splatting monocular training
load_dataset_aria_viewsyn: load an Aria view synthesis dataset with interpolated novel camera poses between keyframes
create_ArialParser: parse Aria or ORB trajectory JSON files to extract camera poses, color paths, and per-frame point clouds
create_ArialDataset: create a PyTorch dataset from Aria config with camera intrinsics, vignette correction, and depth loading
create_Arial_ViewSyn_Dataset: create a novel view synthesis dataset that interpolates camera poses with spiral perturbations between keyframes
